question: __________ has been elected as the 36th President of the Board of Control for Cricket in India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Roger Binny.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Former cricketer Roger Binny **has been elected as the 36th President of the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI).
 
• He replaces **Sourav Ganguly**, who held the post since 2019.
 
• Binny, 67, was one of the architects of India’s 1983 World Cup triumph and president of the Karnataka State Cricket Association.
 
• **Jay Shah** will continue for a second term as the secretary of the BCCI.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
